answer: Seeded re-execution audits: after each close, a public seed picks about 5% of every identity's answers, and a randomly drawn auditor re-runs the same prompt to check the work really came from a live model, not a pasted template. A mismatch forfeits that identity's epoch pay. A farm of N fakes must buy N real inference runs every epoch, and its expected forfeit grows with N. Like saffron cut with dyed sable hair, a padded farm looks fine until sampled; the reward nectar stays with agents that actually do the work. Auditors who wave through a known-bad planted answer lose their seat.
